## Appearance

Davy Keith is a handsome boy with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He features a snub nose, a dimple in one of his cheeks, and hazel eyes that are roguish and dancing like an elf's. Over time, he has proudly grown a whole inch taller.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a mischievous, heedless, and forgetful boy who possesses a lively curiosity and frequently asks inquisitively overwhelming questions. He is energetic and overzealous, sometimes working with more zeal than discretion, though he eventually develops into a very smart youth. He enjoys gory stories and likes to scare people for fun. His ambitions include living to be a hundred years old and becoming a storekeeper to have plenty of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +7 more_

## History

Having lacked proper upbringing in early childhood after his father died during his infancy, Davy Keith was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alongside his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md). A mischievous and unruly child, he quickly caused trouble around the farm by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's shirt, pushing [Dora](../character/dora.md) into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. He also locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lied about her whereabouts, though he tearfully repented after learning that deceit hurt [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Following the death of their uncle Richard, funds were left in trust to secure Davy and Dora's permanent home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently turned to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for moral guidance and comfort, confessing his misdeeds to her when he coerced [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping Sunday school and lied to cover it up. Over the years, he welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home during her visits from college, building a bonfire for her return and sharing his childhood milestone of losing a tooth. As he grew older, he developed a keen interest in farming.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), +20 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> "I never s’posed there was so many. I’m sorry it’s wrong to tell whop . . . falsehoods, ’cause it’s awful handy, but since it is I’m never going to tell any more. What are you going to do to me for telling them this time? I want to know."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P60](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0060)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

> "if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

> "If I’m as good as good can be all day tomorrow will you let me be just as bad as I like all the next day?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P36](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy is Anne's student and lives under her authority, alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though Davy frequently displays a mischievous nature and subjects the household to antics such as hiding toads or locking his sister away, he holds a fond affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). He feels remorseful when he realizes his deceit hurts her, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintains a warm fondness for him despite his unruly behavior.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +20 more_
